PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Public non-PII combat profile and leaderboard stats for a registered player.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

playerName.description: Display callsign chosen by the player.

playerNameLower.description: Lowercase normalized display name for duplicate checking.

dragonKills.description: Total number of times this player has killed the Dragon.

bestTimeMs.description: Fastest Dragon kill duration in milliseconds, or null if zero kills.

lastOutcome.description: Outcome of the player's most recent completed match.

lastDurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds of the player's most recent completed match.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile or match update.

MatchRun.title: MatchRun
MatchRun.description: Immutable completed boss fight outcome record for the live battle feed.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who completed the run.

playerName.description: Player display name at the time of the match.

dragonKilled.description: True only when the Dragon was defeated.

damageDealt.description: Total damage inflicted by the warrior.

critsLanded.description: Critical hits landed during the run.

parriesLanded.description: Perfect parries landed during the run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match ended.

/players/{playerId}.description: Public non-PII player profiles and leaderboard rankings keyed by player UID.

/matches/{matchId}.description: Immutable recent Dragon boss fight outcomes for real-time feed visibility.
